summary: This bill, the "Job Protection Act," expands eligibility for family and medical leave by reducing the required employment period from 12 months to 90 days and broadens employer coverage by applying leave requirements to employers with one or more employees, rather than only those with 50 or more.

scores.thoughts: This bill significantly expands employee eligibility for family and medical leave by reducing the employment duration requirement from 12 months to 90 days and broadening employer coverage to those with 1 or more employees instead of 50 or more. These changes grant more workers access to leave and place more employers under FMLA requirements, which aligns with strengthening labor protections.
